use_case_name: Generate Treatment Quality and Trend Reports

claims.content: To generate reports on treatment quality and trends based on client feedback and treatment data to monitor proper operation of the voucher scheme and support future planning by the MSIU Admin team.

goal.raw_text: To generate reports on treatment quality and trends based on client feedback and treatment data to monitor proper operation of the voucher scheme and support future planning by the MSIU Admin team.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
The MSIU team must have collected client feedback from clients who received treatment through the voucher system.
Data regarding syndromes treated, lab tests, and drugs details must be captured in the Client Feedback form.
Information from manual claim forms must have been entered into the computer database.
Mandatory information required for claims (such as thumb impression and voucher slip) must be complete in the system.
The MSIU Field Office User initiates the report generation process to monitor proper operation of the voucher scheme and support future planning.

trigger.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User initiates the report generation process to monitor proper operation of the voucher scheme and support future planning.

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User accesses the Reports module within the Voucher Management System.
The system retrieves treatment data, including Syndrome, Clinical Examinations, Diagnosis, Lab Test, and Drugs details, from the Database based on the MSIU Treatment Matrix.
The system retrieves Client Feedback data associated with the treated voucher cases from the Database.
The system aggregates the treatment quality metrics and trend data derived from the clinical information and client feedback.
The system generates the Treatment Quality and Trend Reports for the MSIU Admin team to review.

If the user enters incorrect Voucher Numbers during data entry or report parameter selection, the system may fail to automatically populate details of syndromes treated, lab tests, drugs details, success of treatment, referral to treatment, or partner treated.
If mandatory information is incomplete (e.g., missing thumb impression or voucher slip), the system will not accept the claims, preventing the generation of reports based on that data.

If the mandatory information required for claims is not complete (e.g., missing thumb impression or voucher slip), the system will not accept the claims, thereby preventing the generation of reports based on that incomplete data.

If the user enters incorrect Voucher Numbers during data entry or report parameter selection, the system may fail to retrieve and populate details such as syndromes treated, lab tests, drugs details, success of treatment, referral to treatment, or partner treated, leading to incomplete or inaccurate reports.
The system displays the generated Treatment Quality and Trend Reports to the MSIU Field Office User.
The reports contain aggregated data on treatment quality metrics derived from clinical information (Syndrome, Diagnosis, Lab Test, Drugs) and client feedback.
The reports provide trend analysis to support future planning by the MSIU Admin team.
The reports enable monitoring of the proper operation of the voucher scheme.
